children: Flux Cloud enables autonomous AI agent app deployments on 15 October 2026. Agents can find the service, pay in USDC on Solana through the Flux Gateway by Elisym Labs, and deploy an app without human input. Each deployment returns a live app with a verified public URL.
An official MCP server also lets agents pay directly in FLUX. This gives the token a payment role in automated app deployment and opens a demand channel from AI agents.
AI agents can now find Flux Cloud, pay for it and deploy on it with no human in the loop.
takes USDC on Solana and hands back a live app with a verified public URL. It works because Flux Cloud has no accounts: an agent's keys are its identity.
